name: Megasuki! ~Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou~ Amou Haruka Hen
original_name: メガスキ！〜彼女と僕の眼鏡事情〜 天羽遥香編
source:
One day, Haruka Amou arrives as an intern student in the health and physical education department. The main character Souta falls in love at first sight with the cute and innocent Haruka.

Haruka tries her best to get through the training, but fails due to her own big-breasted complex. Souta sees this and offers to be her one-on-one practice partner.

Through repeated private lessons, Haruka gradually gains confidence. And of course, the two grow closer...

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/glasses/megasuki2/haruka.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
某天，天羽遥香作为保健体育科的实习老师来到学校。主角飒太对这位可爱纯真的遥香一见钟情。

遥香为了完成实习而努力，却因对自己胸部过于丰满的自卑，不断受挫。飒太见状，主动提出，做她一对一的练习搭档。

在反复的私人课程中，遥香逐渐找回自信。当然，两人的关系也越来越亲近……
